primary_research.title: Ravindran and Barto, Relativized Options: Choosing the Right Transformation (ICML 2003)
primary_research.use: Shared relative option representation and state-dependent action maps; exact homomorphism conditions versus heuristic approximate transformation. Its discounted learning experiment is not native SSP qualification.

primary_research.title: Junges et al., Parameter Synthesis for Markov Models: Covering the Parameter Space
primary_research.use: Parameterized transition models distinguish structure from numerical valuation. No general symbolic parameter-synthesis engine is selected.

primary_research.title: Bonet and Geffner, General Policies, Serializations, and Planning Width
primary_research.use: Generalized subgoal sketches as search guidance. Classical termination/width conclusions do not establish stochastic properness or economic optimality here.

primary_research.title: Yang et al., PG3: Policy-Guided Planning for Generalized Policy Generation (IJCAI 2022)
primary_research.use: Distinguish a policy used to guide planning from one used as an unverified executable answer. No training or learned planner in this implementation.
